summary: Frontend-only visual regression test for the new BoardingPassCard component on the Store screen. Verified all 6 event boarding-pass cards (halloween, thanksgiving, holiday, ailab-showcase, openhouse, games) and both fundraising boarding-pass cards (fund-card-ailab, fund-card-aihs) render correctly with the boarding-pass aesthetic: brand strip 'DIGITAL-UNI AI TRAIN + LEARN · CERTIFY · BUILD · BELONG', gold SCHOOL OF AI / AI LAB RESEARCH / AI HIGH SCHOOLS pill, event title/subtitle, dark price panel with BOARDING PASS + EVENT TICKET/DONATION TICKET kicker + TICKET PRICE + range, cream footer with mini QR + correct DU-{EVENT}-2026 / DU-FUND-AILAB-2026 / DU-FUND-AIHS-2026 ref IDs + gold ADMIT ONE / SUPPORTER pill, and italic 'EDUCATION HAS NO BORDERS.' strip. Tier pill buttons (Admit One / VIP / Premiere) below each event still function — tapping Halloween VIP shows ×1 and adds $500 to cart which is reflected in Checkout. Fundraising chip rows (100/1000/10000/100000/1000000) below each fund card still work — tapping fund-ailab-100/1000/10000 and fund-aihs-1000/100000 correctly toggles ×1 badges and increments the header cart count (verified 6 items after adds). Single-tier event (games) also works. Overall: 100% pass on the requested scope. No deprecated packages, no red screens, no console errors relevant to this change. Regression flow (Store → tap tier pill → header cart count updates → Checkout page renders line item + $ total) is intact.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is 1419 lines — well over the 700 line soft limit. Consider splitting each view (StoreView, CheckoutView, HomeView, etc.) into dedicated files under /app/frontend/src/screens/ for maintainability. Not blocking for this iteration.
